JEWEL C++ cascade validation

Compare the C++ shower engine with the frozen JEWEL 2.6.0 physics routines.

Full generator validation is unfinished. These inputs are a controlled 100 GeV parent split, not Pythia-generated dijet events. There is no hadronization. The diagnostic Fortran scheduler stops at nonfinite branch states; its physics routines are unchanged. These results do not establish the final full-feature acceptance goal.

Definitions and provenance

Final shower partons have status 4 or 5. Status-3 medium recoils are excluded. Anti-kt clustering uses hepyy/cppyy FastJet; selection is applied after clustering. Girth is Σ pT,i ΔRηφ,i / Σ pT,i. pTD is √Σ pT,i² / Σ pT,i.

Invalid and discarded attempts contribute zero jets. Unit weights are used; this is not a cross-section prediction. Error estimates use paired attempts and keep jet correlations within each event. Empty reference bins have undefined ratios.
